content: Eternal Terminal: etserver accepts TCP (2022), SSH used only for initial auth bootstrap then ID/passkey pair issued; etterminal process per session holds the shell+PTY and survives disconnects; reconnect with same ID/passkey reattaches via UserTerminalRouter/Handler; protobuf protocol (InitialPayload/TerminalBuffer/TerminalInfo/KeepAlive); BackedReader/BackedWriter with sequence numbers retransmit lost data on reconnect (reliable stream buffer doubles as replay); keepalive-driven reconnection.
